candidate_workaround: Set PYTHONUTF8=1 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 for Method Flow validate and summarize commands, then verify both summary files parse or read.
failure_signature: The Method Flow summary command wrote through CP1252 stdout and raised UnicodeEncodeError on Māori text after ledger validation.
recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 before every family runner that may print phase text, not only skill-creator tools.
rollback: Retain the valid ledger and failed command, then regenerate only derived summaries under UTF-8.
scope_boundary: Derived Method Flow summary evidence only; no scientific or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Pin UTF-8 for family-runner stdout and summaries
trigger_preconditions: A family runner prints phase content containing Māori or other non-CP1252 text.
